### Experiment design

The visual layout of the experiment for five subjects is shown in @fig-exp-design. Each subject completed $20$ trials: $15$ SAME trials, in which the same data structure was shown in both the $2\text{-}D$ NLDR plot and the tour; $4$ DIFFERENT trials, showing DIFFERENT data structures; and one attention check trial that could be either SAME or DIFFERENT. The purpose of the DIFFERENT trials was to ensure that subjects didn't get too familiar with the task, which might happen if the data is always the same in both graphics.  For the SAME, five NLDR methods (*tSNE, UMAP, PHATE, PaCMAP, and TriMAP*) were each paired with three of five distance scale factors (*small, small-medium, medium, medium-large, and large*), giving $15$ balanced combinations. In the DIFFERENT, four NLDR methods were randomly selected, with the remaining method assigned to the attention check trial. All DIFFERENT and attention check trials used a distance scale factor of *medium-large*.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8
#| label: fig-exp-design
#| fig-pos: "!ht"
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-cap: "Experimental design for ten subjects. Shapes represent NLDR methods, and fill colors denote distance scale factors, ranging from low to high separability and mapped from light to dark. The figure shows only the SAME trials, making it easier to see the balanced design: for each subject, all five NLDR methods (tSNE, UMAP, PHATE, TriMAP, and PaCMAP) are equally represented, and each method appears with three of the five distance scale factors (small, small–medium, medium, medium–large, and large), distributed across subjects. The order of trials is randomized within each subject. In the full experiment (not shown), DIFFERENT trials and attention checks were inserted at random positions. Each subject completed $20$ trials in total: $15$ SAME trials, $4$ DIFFERENT trials comparing different data structures, and $1$ attention check (SAME or DIFFERENT). All DIFFERENT and attention-check trials used a medium–large distance scale factor."

experiment_design01 <- read_rds(here::here("data/vis-exp/experiment_design_with_methods_and_distance_factor_missings_batch04.rds")) |>
  filter(subject %in% c(paste0("subject", 67:76))) |>
  mutate(
    subject = as.integer(factor(subject))  # 1–10
  )

# Prepare dataset
plot_data <- experiment_design01 |>
  select(subject, attempt, method, is_same, is_attention_check, distance_factor) |>
  filter(is_same == "SAME") |>
  filter(is_attention_check == "NO") |>
  mutate(
    # Recode distance factor
    distance_sf = recode(as.character(distance_factor),
                         `0.1` = "S",
                         `0.6` = "SM",
                         `0.9` = "M",
                         `1`   = "ML",
                         `1.1` = "L"),
    # Recode method names
    method = recode(as.character(method),
                    tsne   = "tSNE",
                    umap   = "UMAP",
                    phate  = "PHATE",
                    trimap = "TriMAP",
                    pacmap = "PaCMAP"),
    # Stroke size for attention check
    stroke_size = ifelse(is_attention_check == "YES", 1.3, 0.5),
    # Fill color: solid for SAME, hollow for DIFFERENT
    is_same_fill = ifelse(is_same == "SAME", distance_sf, "white")
  ) |>
  # Group by subject to assign horizontal positions
  group_by(subject) |>
  arrange(attempt) |>
  mutate(trial_pos = (row_number() - 1) * 6) |>  # increased spacing
  ungroup() |>
  # Reverse factor levels so first subject is on top
  mutate(subject_id = factor(subject, levels = rev(unique(subject))),
         method = factor(method, levels = c("tSNE","UMAP","PHATE","TriMAP","PaCMAP")),
         is_same_fill = factor(is_same_fill, levels = c("S","SM","M","ML","L", "white")))

# Define colors for distance factor
distance_colors <- c(
  "S"  = "#fef0d9",
  "SM" = "#fdcc8a",
  "M"  = "#fc8d59",
  "ML" = "#e34a33",
  "L"  = "#b30000"
)

# Define shapes for methods
method_shapes <- c(
  "tSNE"   = 21,
  "UMAP"   = 24,
  "PHATE"  = 22,
  "TriMAP" = 23,
  "PaCMAP" = 25
)

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = trial_pos, y = subject_id)) +
  geom_point(aes(
    shape = method,          # map method to shape (legend appears)
    fill = is_same_fill,     # distance factor for SAME trials
    stroke = stroke_size
  ),
  size = 5,                 # slightly smaller shapes to avoid overlap
  color = "black") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes, name = "NLDR Method") +
scale_fill_manual(values = distance_colors, na.value = "white", name = "Distance Factor",
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = distance_colors))) +
  scale_y_discrete(name = "Subject") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Trial", breaks = NULL, expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  ) 
```
